_comment: Copy to config.json on the Pi and fill in. config.json is gitignored:
it holds the panel password and must never be committed.
bind: the Pi's LAN address. NOT 0.0.0.0 - the server refuses that,
because the Pi joins networks you do not control. Use the address
the phone reaches it on (wlan0), or 0 on a wired-only setup.
password: generate one, do not reuse anything. On the Pi:
Basic auth over plain HTTP puts this on the wire base64-encoded on
every request, so treat it as a LAN-only secret with no other use.
git_remote: the pin. `pull` verifies origin matches this EXACTLY and
refuses otherwise, so the update channel cannot be repointed at
another repository. Copy it from `git -C <repo> remote get-url origin`.
